name: ratatouille
description: Assistente de cozinha para tablet. Ferramentas de dados na raiz; a app vive em app/.

scripts.build: npm run validate && npm run bundle && npm --prefix app run build
scripts.dev: npm run bundle && npm --prefix app run dev
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && npm --prefix app run typecheck
scripts.check: npm run validate && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test
